questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 04 Question 1: A solid cylinder and a hollow cylinder of equal mass and radius roll down an inclined plane without slipping starting from rest. Which body reaches the bottom first?
options: Solid cylinder reaches first because its rotational inertia factor is smaller
Hollow cylinder reaches first because its rotational inertia factor is larger
Both reach simultaneously because masses and radii are equal
The outcome depends on the inclination angle theta
questions.correctAnswer: Solid cylinder reaches first because its rotational inertia factor is smaller
questions.solution: Acceleration in pure rolling is a = g*sin(theta) / (1 + k^2/R^2). For solid cylinder k^2/R^2 = 0.5 whereas for hollow cylinder k^2/R^2 = 1.0, so solid cylinder has higher acceleration and arrives first.
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 07 Sections & Exercises

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 04 Question 36: A uniform circular disc of mass M = 37 kg and radius R = 1 m rotates about its central perpendicular axis. What is its moment of inertia in kg*m^2?
questions.solution: Moment of inertia of a uniform circular disc about central perpendicular axis is I = 0.5 * M * R^2 = 0.5 * 37 * 1 = 18.5 kg*m^2.
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 07 Sections & Exercises

questions.stem: In Schedule 04 Question 43: A uniform circular disc of mass M = 44 kg and radius R = 2 m rotates about its central perpendicular axis. What is its moment of inertia in kg*m^2?
questions.solution: Moment of inertia of a uniform circular disc about central perpendicular axis is I = 0.5 * M * R^2 = 0.5 * 44 * 4 = 88 kg*m^2.
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 07 Sections & Exercises
